name: tribe
description: A tribe of collaborating agents for product delivery. The Shaman answers What & Why — a ranked, dependency-sequenced backlog of full-context idea cards with a decision-authority split. The Warchief answers How — it turns an approved idea into a context-full spec + bite-sized TDD plan, orchestrates the build, audits it with the adversarial-reviewer, and lands a green PR with before/after evidence — while delegating the actual coding to a Hunter implementer and never writing feature source itself.
